description: The synthetic scan as a triangle soup (no indices, three vertices per triangle, 2 charts), and two indexed triangles whose corners only an exact weld can tell apart: one pair differs by the sign of a zero, another only in a morph target.

weld.why: Soup: the indexed scan it was unrolled from, whose seam vertices differ in UV. Quads: corners 2 and 5 merge (−0 is 0), 1 and 3 stay apart (the target moves 3).

notes: Bounds are the generator's float32 positions through the node transforms.
Occupancy is not stated: this fixture is for geometry.
